Understanding your organisation

What is your organisational structure?

Leading a ward is essential to leading safely.

  • Be accountable for the ward.
  • Know and use escalation pathways.

Example of an organisational structure:

Welsh Government
Health Board / Trust
Ward

Who is in your directorate?

Knowing who is in your directorate helps you access the right support.

  • Directorate Manager: Overall management of the directorate.
  • Clinical Director: Leads on the clinical services.


Download a template (PDF, 1 page, 1MB) to complete.

Understand your organisation's vision

  1. Understand and model the vision, values, and behaviours.
  2. Work with your ward team to translate these principles.
